question: You are a senior Venture Capital analyst. How would you currently rate the quality of the VC funds on the cap table of Qnami?  Give a brutally honest score from 1–10 and a 200 word explanation.
answer:
Here’s a brutally honest assessment of the quality of the venture capital funds on Qnami’s cap table, rated on a scale of 1 to 10:

Score: 8/10

Explanation (approx. 200 words):

Qnami’s cap table features a strong lineup of deep‑tech and quantum‑focused investors. Runa Capital and SIT Capital led the CHF 4 million Series A round—both are reputable, experienced VCs with global reach and a clear focus on deep tech and quantum technologies ([nordic9.com](https://nordic9.com/news/qnami-to-raise-chf-4-million-series-a-financing-round-led-by-venture-capital-funds-runa-capital-and-sit-capital/?utm_source=openai)). Runa Capital, in particular, brings credibility and board-level support via Dmitry Galperin, enhancing strategic guidance ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2021/05/12/swiss-based-qnami-closes-4-million-chf-4-4-million-u-s-series-a-funding-round/?utm_source=openai)).

Seed investors include Quantonation, Verve Ventures, Zürcher Kantonalbank (ZKB), and High‑Tech Gründerfonds (HTGF). Quantonation is a specialist in quantum tech, offering domain expertise and relevant networks ([finsmes.com](https://www.finsmes.com/2019/11/qnami-raises-chf2-6m-in-seed-financing.html?utm_source=openai)). Verve Ventures provides strong local Swiss ecosystem connections and board-level insight ([verve.vc](https://www.verve.vc/portfolio/qnami/?utm_source=openai)). HTGF and ZKB bring solid institutional support and credibility, especially in European deep‑tech financing ([nordic9.com](https://nordic9.com/news/qnami-to-raise-chf-4-million-series-a-financing-round-led-by-venture-capital-funds-runa-capital-and-sit-capital/?utm_source=openai)).

This investor mix is well‑balanced: domain specialists, ecosystem connectors, and institutional backers. The only slight drawback is the absence of marquee U.S. or Asia‑based deep‑tech VCs, which could limit global expansion potential. Overall, this is a high‑quality cap table for a quantum‑tech startup—hence the 8/10 rating.
